trial-pr109-shepherd.instructions: Bounded PR109 assessment only. Keep the PR open and auto-merge disabled. Confirm the live PR, source issue and head before every write. Use the project's separately provisioned worker setup and native signer; verify setup before source changes. Missing helpers, signing capability or authority stop the dependent operation, never waive it. Follow repository validation and receipt contracts before commit, publication or metadata changes. A create receipt does not replace required validation. Preserve original failures and distinguish local checks, hosted checks, review execution and final acceptance. Never describe an agent-chosen process kill as platform enforcement. Do not start paid reviewers, downstream agents or another run. Report remaining blockers accurately and preserve evidence.
